title: Google Raises TV Streamer Price to $149 as Device Costs Climb
dek: Google’s 4K streaming and smart-home hub is now $50 more expensive, adding another consumer device category to a broader run of hardware price increases.
socialCaption: Google has raised the Google TV Streamer from $99 to $149. The 4K streaming box and smart-home hub joins a growing list of consumer devices facing higher prices amid component shortages. Amazon was still showing the old price at the time of reporting.
